source: Fresh local Kimodo SOMA RP v1.1 / gaunt crooked supernatural skinwalker

guardianMotion.style: narrow gaunt crooked hunch; delayed asymmetric shoulders, low projecting neck and loose tense claw hands
guardianMotion.contactMethod: real FK ankle, ToeBase and oriented heel sole height baselines plus horizontal world velocities, circular threeframe smoothing
guardianMotion.strideScalePolicy: source clip speeds are native; multiply once by measured target/source leg length in runtime
